turns.text: Hey Kemi! Looks like Dayo sent you over. I set up an AI receptionist that answers your shop's phone and books people in. Takes about five minutes. What's the business called?
Kemi Cuts, barber shop in Frisco
Nice, barbers are a great fit. Do you have a website or Google listing I can pull your details from?
Got it. I'm grabbing you a local number now. While that runs, what are your hours? Just type them however, like 'Tue–Sat 9 to 6'.
